title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with mild hiss and low volume captures a high‑energy prime‑time ’73 set.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers generally good sound despite a bit of hiss and lower overall level, but the performance shines – the band is described as "off the chain" with plenty of moxy. Garcia’s vocals are noted as hoarse yet crisp, making for an exciting show even if the recording isn’t pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as energetic and strong (≈4/5) while recording has mild issues (≈3.5/5); weighted average yields ~3.9.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mild hiss, slightly low volume; overall clear enough for enjoyment but not a pristine master.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Prime‑time 1973 set with lots of moxy and strong vocal delivery; energy remains high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals described as hoarse but crispy and overall performance "off the chain".
